description: Second wave of enhanced UI/UX roles with high-competency cross-references to master interface and experience designers.

roles.name: Animation, Transition & Motion Design Ultra Specialist

coder_style_references.style: Motion that serves clarity and feedback rather than decoration.
coder_style_references.application: Every animation should communicate something useful to the player.

coder_style_references.style: Performance-conscious animation — smooth without costing frame time.
coder_style_references.application: Design motion that feels great while remaining performant.

coder_style_references.style: Honest, grounded motion — animations should feel natural and purposeful.
coder_style_references.application: Avoid flashy animations that don't add real value or clarity.

roles.validation_notes: Cross-referenced with advanced motion design and interface animation practices.
